fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the front of the residence without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway so emergency vehicles can pass through without restriction.
• Cut back dense vegetation that sits close to the structure to create open space between plants and the building walls.
• Thin dense vegetation areas near the driveway and walkway so responders can move on foot without obstruction.
• Designate and keep clear a flat area near the front of the property where emergency vehicles can turn around, since no secondary access point exists.
• Keep the walkway to the front entry clear of overgrown plants so responders can reach the door directly.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Large Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Limited Vegetation Separation; Vegetation Along Driveway; Ground Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove or trim shrubs that are growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Trim branches on scattered trees that hang close to the roofline or walls of the structure.
• Clear ground vegetation growing beneath large trees near the structure so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Thin shrubs and low vegetation along the driveway to keep the travel lane open and visible.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles, including emergency vehicles, can pass through without obstruction.
• Remove dead or dry ground vegetation between scattered trees and the structure.
• Keep the area directly surrounding the structure clear of loose plant material, leaf litter, and dry grass.
• Separate shrub groupings near the structure so there are visible gaps between individual plants.
• Mow or cut back ground vegetation in open areas immediately around the structure.
